item.title: Disney D23 2026: Everything announced for Star Wars, Marvel, and more
item.summary: The annual Disney fan event showed off the cast of Marvel’s X-Men movie, plus a new trailer for Avengers: Doomsday, and our first look at the VisionQuest TV show for Disney Plus.
